Package game.actions

Interface Sellable

All Known Implementing Classes:
Diamond, Egg, Milk, SellableItem, Stone
public interface Sellable
Interface representing an item in an actor's inventory that can be sold to a buyer (e.g., Merchant).

    • sell

      String sell(Actor seller, MerchantContext merchantContext)
      Completes the sale of this item, including payment and any item-specific side effect.

      Precondition: the item has already been removed from seller's inventory. The calling SellAction does this before calling, so implementations do not remove it themselves.

      Parameters:
      seller - the Actor selling this item
      merchantContext - the merchant buying it and its current Location
      Returns:
      a description of the outcome
